globalAttributes.title: b'L2 Magnetometer (MAG) Geomagnetic Field 1-minute Averages Product with Complete Coordinate Frames'
globalAttributes.summary: b"The GOES-R spacecraft includes a pair of fluxgate magnetometer instruments which operate simultaneously to obtain measurements of the geomagnetic field. The Magnetometer Subsystem supports the following mission objectives: 1) Map the space environment that controls charged particle dynamics in the outer region of the magnetosphere, 2) Measure the magnitude and direction of the Earths 'ambient magnetic field in three orthogonal directions in the geosynchronous equatorial orbit, 3) Determine general level of geomagnetic activity, and 4) Detect magnetopause crossings, storm sudden commencements, and substorms. The one-minute averages product described in this file includes the magnetometer observations in several coordinate systems."
